description:
[x402 Paywall] Paywall a new endpoint with x402 pay-per-call, settled in USDC straight to payTo. With upstreamUrl, paid requests are proxied to your backend. Applies live within ~20s (needs PAYWALL_API_KEY).

Use when you want to put one HTTP endpoint behind x402 pay-per-call, paid in USDC straight to your wallet. Not for many routes at once (use paywall_import_routes).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

asset.description: Payment token contract; defaults to USDC on the network.

description.description: Up to 200 chars: letters, digits, space . _ -

network.description: CAIP-2 id: Base mainnet eip155:8453, Base Sepolia eip155:84532.

payTo.description: Your payout wallet (0x…). Settlement pays here directly; nothing is custodied.

upstreamUrl.description: Your https backend. Omit for the demo confirmation payload.
